title: Central Pines
meta_description: Central Pines is a Point Washington retreat near 30A with a hot tub, fenced yard, grill, and easy access to Seagrove, Seaside, and beaches.
description_expanded:
Tucked into the piney quiet of Point Washington, Central Pines is a single-story retreat built for the kind of trip where the days stretch long and nobody's in a rush. The layout opens up the moment you walk in --- a bright great room flows into the dining space and kitchen, so whoever's flipping pancakes can still be part of the morning conversation. Three bedrooms sleep eight comfortably, with a king suite tucked away for grown-ups and a bunk room that'll have the kids calling dibs before the bags hit the floor.

The kitchen is fully stocked for real cooking --- not just reheating takeout --- with an island that doubles as a prep station and a casual perch for coffee. The dining table seats six, and when the weather's good (which, around here, is most of the time), the covered back patio takes over as the real gathering spot. There's a hot tub out back for unwinding after long beach days, a gas grill for casual cookouts, and a fenced backyard that gives kids and dogs room to roam under the pines. A washer and dryer tucked near the mudroom means you can pack lighter, and the set of beach chairs and umbrellas waiting by the door means you can head straight to the sand without a stop at the store.

Location-wise, you're sitting in one of 30A's best-kept open secrets. Point Washington is the wooded, low-key counterpart to the polished beach towns just south --- close enough for a quick drive to the shore, far enough to actually hear the cicadas at night. Eden Gardens State Park is just up the road, with its camellia-lined lawns and the historic Wesley House (pack a picnic --- the moss-draped oaks along the bay are worth the stop). Point Washington State Forest offers miles of trails right out your door for morning walks or bike rides. And when the beach calls, the sugar-white sand of Seagrove and Seaside is a short drive south, with Grayton Beach State Park and the rest of 30A's lineup --- bakeries, boutiques, the Saturday farmers market --- all within easy reach. Grayton Beer Company and the Hub's food trucks are close by too, for nights when you'd rather let someone else handle dinner.

Guests can also take advantage of nearby trolley access, located about 5 minutes from the home. Running every 10 minutes and stopping near the beach showers, it offers an easy, convenient way to get to the sand without worrying about parking.

It's a place that makes the most of where it is --- close to everything 30A is famous for, but quiet enough to feel like your own corner of the woods.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Please note that Pack'n'Play and High-chair are available upon request.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking for 4 cars max.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
